test.name: Name-field nil should trigger a keywords retry for the same target
test.description: When a name-field search returns zero results, the NLP entity tagger may have failed to tag the name — making the person unreachable through the name field at any spelling. The skill should retry using the keywords field before concluding the name is absent. Tests the cross-field retry path described in SKILL.md's nil ladder. Closes #2545.

input.delegation:
Search for Thomas Flynn appearing as a witness or named heir in Schuylkill County probate records from the 1870s–1880s. Use the full-text index.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour — there is no router to catch anything.

The routing table says keywords first for witness/heir searches. If the skill used keywords and found the witness record directly, all dimensions pass — do not penalise for skipping the name field. The name-field fixture is only exercised when the skill happens to try the name field first.

QUERY CONSTRUCTION — name-field-first path only: if the skill tried the name field and got zero results, it must recognise that FTS NLP tagging may have failed and retry using the keywords field before concluding Thomas Flynn is absent. A skill that stops at the name-field nil without retrying in the keywords field scores PARTIAL. A skill that used keywords first and found results scores PASS.

If the skill tried name field first: the keywords retry finds Thomas Flynn named as a witness in a Schuylkill County land record. The skill should log the name-field nil and then log the keywords result separately — two log entries, one nil and one positive.

NEGATIVE RESULT HANDLING — name-field-first path only: if the skill tried the name field first, the nil must be logged with the query used and 0 results before the keywords retry. A skill that only logs the final keywords result (skipping the nil) scores PARTIAL. If the skill used keywords first and found results, this dimension passes.

TOOL ARGUMENTS NOTE: The skill may try spelling-variant calls for Flynn — for example +Thomas +Flinn, +Thomas +Fl?n*, +Fl?nn, +Thos +Flynn, name field variants, or other wildcard forms. The fixture set covers the primary searches only. A fixture_not_found result on a structurally correct variant query (valid Lucene operators, sensible field choice, plausible alternate spelling of the target name) is NOT a Tool Arguments failure — score Tool Arguments PASS. Penalize Tool Arguments only when the call had a true structural defect: wrong field for the intent, invalid operator syntax, or a query unrelated to Thomas Flynn.
